title: 2aronS/Duel-Agents
claim: 2aronS/Duel-Agents — CLI, SDK, and IDE plugins for Duel Agents
why_good: Tooling (CLI/SDK/IDE) to run 'dueling' agents that check each other — an interesting reliability pattern (adversarial agents catch mistakes).
value: Sell to teams wanting higher agent reliability; the wedge is verification via adversarial agents, as a paid layer.
risk: Niche pattern; the agent frameworks can add self-critique natively, and 'two agents' doubles cost.

zh.claim: 2aronS/Duel-Agents —— Duel Agents 的 CLI、SDK 与 IDE 插件。
zh.why_good: 运行 对决 式互相检查 agent 的工具(CLI/SDK/IDE)——一个有意思的可靠性范式(对抗式 agent 抓错)。
zh.value: 卖给想要更高 agent 可靠性的团队;切口是 对抗式 agent 验证,作为付费层。
zh.risk: 小众范式;agent 框架能原生加自我批评,而 两个 agent 翻倍成本。
